title: Coupe
driverAssistBrand: McLaren Technology Pack (no branded hands-off system; manufacturer does not offer SAE Level 2 hands-off cruise)
infotainment: McLaren IRIS Next-Gen with 8-inch HD center touchscreen and 10.25-inch driver display. Wireless Apple CarPlay standard via Smartphone Integration Package. Source: https://www.mclarenhouston.com/2026-mclaren-artura
adasStandard: Limited. Standard ADAS includes lane departure warning, traffic sign recognition (basic), and a reversing camera. McLaren prioritizes driver involvement over driver assistance. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/mclaren/artura/2025/features-specs/
adasOptional: Technology Pack ($7,400) adds road sign recognition with active intervention, 360-degree parking assistance, and intelligent adaptive cruise control. Blind-spot monitoring and rear cross-traffic alert are also optional. Source: https://carbuzz.com/cars/mclaren/artura/2025/
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard rear-view camera. Resolution unspecified by manufacturer; reviews describe it as adequate but not class-leading. Single-angle (no multi-angle modes). Source: https://www.edmunds.com/mclaren/artura/2025/features-specs/
sideViewCameraNotes: 360-degree surround-view camera included only with optional Technology Pack ($7,400). No dedicated side-blind camera (Honda LaneWatch-style) or trailer view. Source: https://carbuzz.com/cars/mclaren/artura/2025/
subscriptionFeatures: No subscription-gated driving features. McLaren Pure Connect is the only connectivity service and is bundled with new car sales for an initial period; renewal is at owner option but its lapse does not disable heated seats, ADAS, performance, or any other in-car function. Source: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ikontechnologies.mclarenpure.connect
drmNotes: Car operates fully offline. McLaren Pure Connect connected-services app is optional (vehicle tracking, geofencing, valet mode, service reminders) and lapsing does not disable any driving functions. Track Telemetry is a one-time paid software unlock through IRIS infotainment, not a recurring subscription. No OTA updates that change vehicle behavior post-sale; firmware updates are dealer-applied. Source: https://cars.mclaren.com/gl_en/ownership/mclaren-track-telemetry
killSwitchNotes: No impaired-driving-detection kill switch present. The 2025 Artura predates any active NHTSA rulemaking on Section 24220 IIJA implementation. Source: manufacturer specifications.
knownIssues: 12V hybrid charging system failures causing inability to unlock or release doors (early builds, largely resolved). Transmission oil leaks documented in NHTSA TSB MC-11012444 (May 2025). Owner reports on McLarenLife forum cite multi-week dealer waits for hybrid-system parts. Source: https://www.mclarenlife.com/threads/reliability-issues-with-my-2025-artura.118924/ ; https://www.hotcars.com/mclaren-arturas-problem-is-a-warning-for-all-hybrid-supercars/
recalls: Brake line routing recall (NHTSA, 2020-2025 Artura, GT, GTS, 600LT, 720S): brake lines may be routed incorrectly, possibly causing a rear wheel to lock. Dealer inspection and correction free of charge. Earlier 2023-2024 builds also covered by high-pressure and low-pressure fuel pipe recalls (loosening nuts / detaching pipe) and 2023 battery-fire moisture-ingress recall. Source: https://www.cars.com/research/mclaren-artura/recalls/
stateIncentives: Data unavailable: McLaren Artura's $254,100+ MSRP exceeds the cap of virtually every state PHEV incentive program (e.g., California CVRP $60k MSRP cap). No state-level purchase incentives apply.

title: Spider

adasStandard: Limited. Standard ADAS includes lane departure warning, traffic sign recognition (basic), and a reversing camera. McLaren prioritizes driver involvement over driver assistance. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/mclaren/artura-spider/2025/features-specs/

sideViewCameraNotes: 360-degree surround-view camera included only with optional Technology Pack. No side-blind camera or trailer view.

subscriptionFeatures: No subscription-locked driving features. McLaren Pure Connect (vehicle tracking, geofencing, valet mode) is the only renewable service and is purely informational.
drmNotes: Operates fully offline. McLaren Pure Connect connected services are optional and lapse does not disable any driving function. Track Telemetry is a one-time IRIS unlock, not a subscription. stateIncentives: Data unavailable: $260,400 MSRP exceeds state PHEV incentive caps (e.g., California CVRP $60k cap).

title: Standard
warrantyBattery: 6yr/45k mi (high-voltage hybrid components, standard McLaren coverage)
infotainment: McLaren bespoke driver-focused display. Specific screen sizes and CarPlay support for the W1 have not been publicly detailed as of 2026-05-21. Source: https://cars.mclaren.com/us_en/W1
adasStandard: Limited; full ADAS spec for the W1 has not been published in customer-facing materials. The W1's Aerocell carbon monocoque and active aero focus is on track performance, not driver-assistance. Source: https://cars.mclaren.com/us_en/W1
adasOptional: Data unavailable: McLaren has not published a Technology Pack or comparable optional ADAS bundle for the W1 as of 2026-05-21. The W1 is invitation-only and bespoke-configured per buyer.
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard rear-view camera assumed (all McLaren road cars include one), but McLaren has not published resolution or multi-angle details for the W1. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/McLaren_W1
sideViewCameraNotes: Data unavailable: No public detail on side-view or surround-view cameras for the W1 as of 2026-05-21.
subscriptionFeatures: No subscription-gated driving features documented. The W1 is sold as a fully-owned asset to vetted buyers with no recurring service tied to vehicle capability.
drmNotes: Operates fully offline. As an ultra-low-volume Ultimate Series car, the W1 carries the same McLaren connectivity posture as the Artura — no required connectivity, no OTA behavior changes, no remote feature reduction. Source: https://cars.mclaren.com/us_en/W1
killSwitchNotes: No impaired-driving-detection kill switch in MY26 build. McLaren has issued no Section 24220 statement.
knownIssues: Data unavailable: Customer deliveries begin in 2026 and no owner reliability data exists yet as of 2026-05-21.
recalls: No W1-specific recalls as of 2026-05-21. Source: https://www.cars.com/research/mclaren/recalls/
stateIncentives: Not applicable: $2.1M MSRP exceeds every US PHEV incentive program by orders of magnitude.
